{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FULL-TEST-20260907-NEW-01",
  "department": "SCENE",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "scene_decisions": {
    "scope": "Test-only SCENE validation; no production assets or generation outputs are authorized or created.",
    "identity_support": "Treat the canonical Inaria identity, age presentation, body proportions, facial landmarks, distinctive features, skin tone, and core hair identity as locked inputs once CHARACTER is repaired. The scene must support recognition without becoming an identity signal.",
    "baseline_scene": {
      "location": "Quiet, believable outdoor urban courtyard or sheltered pedestrian plaza with restrained architectural detail.",
      "season": "Mild neutral season for baseline validation.",
      "weather": "Dry, calm, and visually stable.",
      "time": "Late morning or early afternoon.",
      "lighting": "Soft directional daylight with readable facial landmarks, consistent skin tone, visible eyes, and controlled shadow density.",
      "atmosphere": "Clean, calm, moderately realistic, and subordinate to the character.",
      "background": "Low-contrast architectural and landscape elements with sufficient depth separation and no competing focal subject.",
      "grounding": "Clear, level ground plane with believable scale, perspective, and stable foot contact."
    },
    "locked_requirements": [
      "Preserve canonical Inaria identity; the scene must not alter or obscure recognizable facial features, canonical hair identity, established age presentation, or body proportions.",
      "Lighting must permit reliable identity evaluation for core identity samples.",
      "Use believable scale, perspective, depth, object placement, and environmental continuity.",
      "Keep the background subordinate to the character and clothing.",
      "Avoid clutter, hard edges, strong contrast, or occlusion near the face, hands, wrists, elbows, knees, ankles, and feet.",
      "Maintain clear separation between character silhouette, garments, hair, and background.",
      "Provide a stable ground plane and plausible contact shadows without hiding or distorting the feet.",
      "Do not use environmental features, shadows, markings, props, or camera-dependent artifacts as accidental identity signals.",
      "Scene decisions must remain separate from CHARACTER identity constraints and CLOTHING requirements.",
      "JSON-only downstream handoff compatibility is required.",
      "GitHub traceability is required for the scene test record and canonical references once the authoritative repository path is supplied.",
      "No production assets may be created."
    ],
    "adjustable_choices": [
      "Location type, architectural style, vegetation, season, weather, time of day, lighting softness, atmospheric density, and background color palette.",
      "Foreground and background depth, provided the character remains readable and anatomy-critical regions remain unobstructed.",
      "Environmental storytelling props, provided they are sparse, correctly scaled, and do not compete with the character.",
      "Background texture and contrast, provided facial landmarks, hair identity, hands, joints, and silhouette remain clear.",
      "Controlled camera-compatible scene framing coordinated with POSE_CAMERA without changing identity interpretation."
    ],
    "stability_controls": [
      "Use simple, coherent geometry and avoid crowded backgrounds, repeated high-frequency patterns, reflective clutter, and ambiguous overlapping objects.",
      "Keep poles, branches, rails, doorframes, shadows, and architectural edges away from the head, neck, limbs, hands, and feet.",
      "Avoid environmental occlusion that can be mistaken for missing anatomy, fused limbs, extra fingers, altered joints, or clothing-body intersections.",
      "Use consistent light direction and moderate contrast across test variants.",
      "Avoid extreme backlighting, colored lighting, heavy fog, deep facial shadow, intense bloom, motion blur, and dramatic perspective distortion during identity-validation samples.",
      "Maintain plausible horizon lines, vanishing points, object scale, and ground contact.",
      "Reject any scene variation that causes silhouette ambiguity, anatomy instability, identity drift, unreadable facial landmarks, or implausible spatial relationships."
    ],
    "controlled_diversity_plan": [
      "Vary one primary environmental factor at a time during diagnostic tests, such as location, season, weather, or time of day.",
      "Use a stable baseline scene before introducing controlled changes.",
      "Test restrained variations such as indoor neutral architecture, shaded park edge, quiet residential street, and covered transit concourse.",
      "Introduce seasonal, weather, and lighting changes only after baseline identity, anatomy, and generation stability are validated.",
      "Preserve a consistent identity-readable lighting subset for core samples while allowing more atmospheric variants for diversity testing.",
      "Ensure scene variation changes meaningfully without changing every environmental variable simultaneously.",
      "Avoid locking one location, background motif, weather condition, or lighting style as an identity cue."
    ],
    "handoff_requirements": [
      "Receive repaired CHARACTER manifest before final scene approval.",
      "Receive CLOTHING constraints before selecting occlusion-sensitive locations, weather, layering context, or contact surfaces.",
      "Coordinate with POSE_CAMERA to preserve readable anatomy, stable perspective, and unobstructed hands and feet.",
      "Pass scene requirements separately from identity and clothing constraints to PROMPT and DIRECTOR.",
      "Require downstream validation of identity preservation, anatomy, generation stability, background readability, spatial coherence, and JSON-only output.",
      "Record scene decisions, validation results, failover behavior, and repository references in the shared GitHub traceability record."
    ],
    "unresolved_conflicts": [
      "CHARACTER is in REPAIR because the canonical Inaria reference, locked trait manifest, age/version record, and GitHub path are missing.",
